description: A seat blocked by PROVIDER_HTTP_400 is followed by native gates that do not all pass.
failure: The provider rejected the request itself, so that seat produced no output and the downstream seats had nothing to build on. The native gates then failed on the missing artifact.

lesson.applicability: Any seat observation with blocked=true and failure_code PROVIDER_HTTP_400.
lesson.cause: The provider rejected the request itself, so that seat produced no output and the downstream seats had nothing to build on. The native gates then failed on the missing artifact.
lesson.correction: On PROVIDER_HTTP_400, treat the seat's output as missing. Do not rely on it, do not assume a retry will succeed, and report the residual failure code instead of a solved state.
lesson.exceptions: Does not cover other provider errors or blocks caused by malformed replies.
lesson.failed_claim: A provider HTTP 400 on one seat is a transient hiccup that later seats will recover from.
lesson.verification: Host replay of recorded host facts over 48 runs: the detector fired in 2 and the outcome followed every time. Proposed by claude-sonnet-5-5. This does not rerun the old checks or show that the guidance helps later runs.
